g.text: Important qualifications to the consistency finding
Left: required 32 x 32 scaling case. Right: 64 problems of size 64 x 80, four workers.
Bars are medians, whiskers are timing-round IQRs (not confidence intervals). Full rank-change lists accompany the report.
